notes.title: Inventory update
notes.notes:
With today's update, an in-game inventory has been added. Now, players have the option to swap the kettlebell on the main game screen! Quickly replace the default kettlebell with a skin from your inventory and enjoy every click!

Stay tuned; there's much more to come!

notes.title: RELEASE!!!
notes.notes:
Our game is finally released!

Starting today, the story of GymBro begins, and YOU can take part in it! The workshop will be added soon, allowing all players to create their own skins for the game!

The project is not yet fully complete and will undergo many improvements and updates! Currently, the main functionality of the game is presented! We have also added a wonderful mini-game that lets you showcase your mouse skills. 

We will share more about the project as the game develops. Stay tuned for updates and keep track of all the changes!

The GymBro Developers.
